buildSourceNote: Build 133 carries v1.1.0-rc.9, the second defect found on the same live journey. The advisor acknowledged the QC pass and recorded the Rs.2000 estimate; GET /api/billing/ready-from-qc listed the vehicle and POST /api/billing/pre-invoice/check-readiness/7386 answered { ready: true, blockers: [] } - every engine gate clear - but the Compile button could only ever answer 403. All five routes the advisor's own screen calls (compile, review, send-to-customer, capture-confirmation, handoff) were authorize("billing", "edit"), and service_advisor holds Billing with can_view 1 / can_edit 0. Billing.edit could not simply be granted instead: it also gates crm-invoice and manual-gate-pass/:mgpId/gm-action, so an advisor could approve a Manual Gate Pass and release a vehicle, contradicting the 2026-09-14 settlement rule. Migration 031 therefore creates module PRE_INVOICE and grants it to service_advisor (plus billing, cashier and gm_service, which already had the capability via Billing.edit), and the five routes are re-gated onto it. Also noted, NOT acted on because creating users is reserved to the owner: production has no billing or cashier user at all, so the billing stage has no operator yet. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
